en: Color street view of a modernist city center with 1970s automobiles and pedestrians. At left stands a cylindrical building with a large vertical sign reading MODAROM (the city's fashion house). To the right is a mid-rise slab hotel with CAPITOL signage on the roofline. Mountains rise in the background. The reverse identifies the scene and publisher in multiple languages.
